head: 8499225d1d4391372e52903a3a0e8ecaab1b3aad
title: Load soundtrack editing controls when the editor opens
body:
Depends on #1619

Opening the soundtrack panel constructs editing controls even when the player only wants playback settings. Move the authoring view into a fixed, lazy-loaded module, and retain the existing panel, playback controls and transaction owners. Guard close/reopen races so an obsolete load cannot attach controls to a closed or newer dialog.

This draft is for source qualification. Keep it unmerged until the P0 published Missions observation has completed.

Validation:
- Independent source, ownership and test-admission review is complete. Latest main was merged normally and the complete resulting blob tree matches the reviewed union.
- Eleven new loader, close/reopen and authoring controls await exact-head execution. Source, full Appearance, Industrial and Company checks remain required.
- Production build and offline/CSP closure remain required. The deferred view is 14,219 source bytes; this does not remove the whole soundtrack module graph or establish a measured browser speedup.

Progress and remaining qualification are tracked in #1623. Physical iPhone/Steam Deck results remain outstanding.
